set.name: Reckoning: Dawn of Heroes
set.theme: Mid-set update to Reckoning. Traits added: Cannoneer, Inanimate, Sentinel, Victorious. Removed: Coven, Dragonslayer, Eternal, God-King, Verdant. Shadow Items removed.

notes.itemScope: Items come from the patch 11.21 CDragon file, filtered to apiName prefixes TFT_Item_,TFT5_Item_, with recipe-less legacy TFT_Item_ entries dropped and entries containing Shadow excluded.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Radiant Items replaced Shadow Items: stronger versions of regular items, one chosen from five at the 3-6 Armory. [11.15 notes]
Divine Blessing: drops once when your Little Legend falls below 40 health; all players get the same essential contents (components, gold, consumables, Spatula, champions). [11.15 notes]
Tome of Traits: consumable; sell it to open a shop of four emblems, including emblems for traits a Spatula cannot build. [11.15 notes]
systemChanges: Armory schedule: 2-2 two components; 3-6 five Radiant items; 4-2 guaranteed (2 components, 3 components, or 3 components plus a special item); 5-2 less likely and never components. [11.15 notes]
Loot orbs: small orb average value 2.54 to 3 gold; minimum after 4-7 is 10 components + 1 Radiant item. [11.15 notes]
Stage 5+ carousels can contain uncraftable emblems; stage 6+ carousels can be all full items. [11.15 notes]

Viego will be interrupted if he is stunned, and Viego's allies prefer not to target his victim during soul corruption. If his victim dies, they are resurrected at full Health to fight for him, but they lose 10/5/0% of their maximum Health per second. Resurrected enemies receive the Trait bonuses of Viego's team instead of their own.

items.description: When combat begins, the holder and all allies within 1 hexes in the same row gain 50% Attack Speed and 10% Lifesteal for the rest of combat.

items.name: Zenith Edge
items.description: Grants 75% Critical Strike Chance (including components) and 10% Critical Strike Damage. Each point of Critical Strike Chance above 100% becomes +1% Critical Strike Damage. Radiant Bonus: +40% Critical Strike Damage. [Unique - only one per champion]

items.name: Zz'Rots Invitation
items.description: At the start of combat, a Radiant Voidmother with bonus Health and Attack Damage arises and taunts enemies within 4 hexes. Radiant Voidmothers that arise from summoned units are 25% effective.
